name: ui-ack
prompt: A single soft UI button click: short muted plastic tap with a gentle high tick, dry, no reverb, quiet and confirmatory.

name: ui-reject
prompt: A dull error thunk: low muted wooden knock followed by a short soft buzz, conveying refusal, dry, not harsh.

name: footstep
prompt: A single soft footstep on stone floor inside a quiet hall: low heel thud with slight room ambience, dry and close.

name: footstep-alt
prompt: A single soft footstep on stone floor, alternate take: slightly lighter toe-first step with faint grit, quiet room tone.

name: task-complete
prompt: A small mechanical task success: a precise metal latch clicking shut followed by a brief warm wooden tick, satisfying and compact.

name: council-bell
prompt: A small brass hand bell rung twice to call a council to order: clear metallic ding with short natural decay in a wood room.

name: eject-whoosh
prompt: A heavy sliding door whoosh followed by a fading air rush, as someone is cast out of a chamber: deep airy sweep, no music.

name: eliminate-thud
prompt: A sudden heavy body thud on a wooden floor with a low muffled rumble, ominous and brief, no scream, no music.

name: victory-fanfare
prompt: A short triumphant brass fanfare: three rising trumpet notes ending on a bright held chord, small ensemble, ceremonial.

name: defeat-drone
prompt: A low somber descending drone: deep cello and muted horn sinking through three falling notes, quiet and resigned.

name: vote-token
prompt: A small clay token dropped into a wooden bowl: single hollow clack with a brief rattle settling, dry and close.

name: clock-tick
prompt: A single quiet mechanical clock tick: tiny precise snap of an escapement, very short, dry, unobtrusive.

name: session-start
prompt: A large clockwork mechanism engaging: a deep winding ratchet followed by a bright brass chime and the whir of gears beginning to turn, ceremonial and warm, no music.

name: undo-rewind
prompt: A short reverse winding sound: a clockwork spring unwinding backwards with a soft tick-tick-tick, dry and mechanical, ending abruptly.

name: hint-whisper
prompt: A soft airy hint cue: a gentle breath of steam through a small brass pipe with a faint rising shimmer, quiet, curious, unobtrusive.

name: achievement-chime
prompt: A small reward chime: two bright glockenspiel notes rising, with a delicate metallic sparkle tail, warm and celebratory, very short.
